title: MT Wood & Fiber Workshop
tagline: Woodworking, sewing & crochet — handmade by Tim & Melody in Las Vegas.
heroText: We are a husband-and-wife workshop bringing woodcraft and fiber arts under one roof. Tim works in wood; Melody sews and crochets. We make useful, giftable pieces with the details and small variations that make handmade work personal.
aboutIntro: MT Wood & Fiber Workshop is the shared workshop of Tim and Melody. The “M” and “T” are us, and the rest of the name reflects the materials we enjoy working with most.
aboutDetails: Tim builds in wood, from practical shop-made tools and clappers to boxes and other small pieces. Melody works in fabric and yarn, sewing and crocheting useful goods for the home and everyday life. We like making things that are meant to be used, given, and kept.
customization: Many pieces can be personalized with choices such as laser engraving, wood inlays, epoxy accents, fabric selections, colors, and other details.
